response:
Diagnosis. The gen-5/gen-6 results converge on a clear conclusion: the *measurement basis* of the accrual leg, not the intangible leg, drives joint strength. One-year balance-sheet (Sloan) accruals paired with the R&D stock remain the best signal in the archive (fmb 3.03, alpha 5.6%, t=6.24, coverage 0.106); cumulating them over three years preserves the slope but costs alpha (4.4%, t=4.70); converting them to a five-year persistence count maximizes the slope (3.60) but collapses alpha to 2.4%. So magnitude-at-one-year is the right accrual state, and the sample gain from avoiding oancf is worth roughly two points of ls_talpha. On the short side the same logic has not yet been applied: the strongest short signal in the whole study (BuyVsBuild, alpha −7.1%, t=−4.70) still uses the oancf wedge, and the best-slope intangible leg ever tested (industry-ranked gross margin, fmb 4.29) has also only been paired with the oancf wedge. With two generations left, this batch upgrades those two high-value legs to the superior accrual measurement, and repairs the abnormal-accrual construction that previously mixed incomparable units.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: BuyVsBuildBalanceSheetAccrual
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(SUB(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), SUB(SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1)), DELTA(txp, 1))), dp), at), 1)), RANK(SUB(RATIO(DELTA(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), 1), at), RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), at))))
HYPOTHESIS: Firms that buy their intangibles instead of building them while reporting accrual-heavy earnings are the study's clearest case of accounting-manufactured growth; measuring those accruals from the balance sheet should sharpen the identification and extend it to the pre-cash-flow-statement era.
EXPECTED_SIGN: negative
REASONING: The buy-versus-build composition leg produced the largest absolute alpha in the archive but with a weak slope (−1.34), and the gen-5 experiment showed that exactly this weakness — a noisy oancf-based accrual on a shortened sample — is what the balance-sheet definition fixes, raising both the slope and the alpha t-stat on the long side. This applies the one demonstrated power upgrade to the strongest untreated mechanism rather than introducing a new formula family.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: MarginBackedBalanceSheetAccrual
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), revt)), RANK(NEG(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(SUB(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), SUB(SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1)), DELTA(txp, 1))), dp), at), 1))))
HYPOTHESIS: Gross margin is the realized output of intangible capital and is observable for every firm, including non-reporters of R&D; combined with balance-sheet-verified clean accruals it should identify proven, cash-consistent pricing power rather than recognition-timing.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The industry-ranked margin leg holds the archive record for cross-sectional slope (4.29) but delivered only 2.7% alpha when paired with the oancf wedge, and the gen-5 evidence attributes exactly that kind of alpha shortfall to accrual measurement and sample length. If the upgrade transfers, this is the batch's best candidate for simultaneously strong fmb_tstat and ls_talpha, and its output-based intangible proxy makes the result independent of R&D disclosure.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: HiddenEquityShareBalanceSheetAccrual
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), ADD(ceq, TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5)))), RANK(NEG(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(SUB(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), SUB(SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1)), DELTA(txp, 1))), dp), at), 1))))
HYPOTHESIS: The mispricing should scale with the *fraction* of a firm's true equity capital that accounting leaves invisible, not with intangible spending per dollar of assets; firms where most economic equity is unrecognized, and whose accruals are clean, are the most misvalued by book-based investors.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Expressing hidden capital as a bounded share of total (reported plus unrecognized) equity avoids the instability of dividing by ceq alone — the flaw that limited the gen-1 hidden-equity signal for low- and negative-equity innovators — and reorders the cross-section toward small-book, research-heavy firms rather than simply asset-light ones. It tests whether the long-side premium is a book-value-distortion effect or an investment-intensity effect, which determines how the final generations should specify the intangible leg.
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: ExcessWorkingCapitalGrowthInnovator
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(SUB(GROWTH(SUB(act, che), 1), GROWTH(sale, 1)), 1)), IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), at)))
HYPOTHESIS: Working capital that grows faster than sales is accrual build-up that the business does not justify, and in intangible-intensive firms — which need little working capital at all — such excess growth marks earnings created by recognition rather than by demand.
EXPECTED_SIGN: negative
REASONING: This repairs the flaw in the gen-4 abnormal-accrual attempt: both terms are now growth rates in identical units, so the construction is a genuine expectation-model residual rather than a difference of incomparable ranks, and no raw growth variable enters with an unintended positive loading. It uses only balance-sheet and income-statement inputs, retaining the coverage advantage (≈0.12) that has accompanied every recent improvement.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: OperatingCycleDeteriorationInnovator
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(TREND(RATIO(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), sale), 5), 1)), IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), at)))
HYPOTHESIS: A multi-year lengthening of the cash conversion cycle is a slow-moving deterioration in earnings quality that investors under-react to, and it is most damaging for intangible-intensive firms whose reported income cannot be checked against tangible fundamentals.
EXPECTED_SIGN: negative
REASONING: The level version of this leg produced solid two-sided short-side evidence in gen 6 (fmb −2.65, alpha −2.5%, t=−2.60) at high coverage; replacing the level with a five-year trend asks whether the pricing information is in the state or in its drift, which is the one temporal question this channel has not been asked. The trend estimator also removes stable business-model differences in working-capital needs that the level cannot separate from deterioration.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: IntangibleOriginBalanceSheetAccrual
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(SUB(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), at), RATIO(COALESCE(intan, 0), at))), RANK(NEG(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(SUB(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), SUB(SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1)), DELTA(txp, 1))), dp), at), 1))))
HYPOTHESIS: Only internally generated intangible capital is genuinely unrecognized; purchased intangibles already sit in book value and carry impairment risk, so the organic-minus-acquired composition, combined with clean balance-sheet accruals, should be a stronger hidden-capital signal than intangible intensity alone.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The composition leg earned 5.4% alpha with the weaker oancf accrual, and applying the demonstrated measurement upgrade tests whether origin adds information beyond scale once the accrual leg is measured well — a question the archive cannot currently answer because the two legs were never varied jointly. It also spans both poles of the theme in one variable, with organic cash-consistent innovators long and acquisition-heavy accrual reporters short.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---CRITIQUE BuyVsBuildBalanceSheetAccrual---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The Hribar–Collins-style balance-sheet accrual re-measurement is a legitimate, sign-consistent power upgrade applied to the archive's largest-alpha leg (buy-vs-build), but it is a one-dimensional measurement swap with no new economics, and the identical swap appears three times in this batch, so at most one such test is informative.

---CRITIQUE MarginBackedBalanceSheetAccrual---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Internally consistent (NEG on the accrual leg correctly makes clean accruals the long side) and the R&D-disclosure-independent margin leg is a real advantage, though the construction is essentially gross-profitability × accruals — two well-known standalone anomalies — recombined with a measurement tweak on an already-archived variant.

---CRITIQUE HiddenEquityShareBalanceSheetAccrual---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: The claimed reordering is illusory because x/(ceq+x) is a monotone transform of x/ceq for all positive-equity firms, so RANK is unchanged except for the handful of negative-equity cases, leaving this a near-duplicate of the archived HiddenEquityCleanAccruals plus the batch's boilerplate accrual swap.

---CRITIQUE ExcessWorkingCapitalGrowthInnovator---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 4
RATIONALE: This is the batch's most substantive construction — a properly unit-matched working-capital-growth-minus-sales-growth residual interacted with intangible intensity, with the expected negative sign matching the expression's direction — though GROWTH(act−che) can be unstable when non-cash current assets are near zero and the leg is cousin to the asset-growth anomaly.

---CRITIQUE OperatingCycleDeteriorationInnovator---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Replacing the archived level of the working-capital cycle with its five-year trend asks a genuine state-versus-drift question and correctly differences out stable business-model differences, but it is a close temporal variant of an already-tested leg and the 5-year estimator will cost coverage and stability.

---CRITIQUE IntangibleOriginBalanceSheetAccrual---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: This is the third instance of the same balance-sheet-accrual substitution applied to an already-archived signal (OrganicMinusAcquiredIntangibleCleanAccrual), adds no variation to the intangible leg that the archive has not already seen, and is mislabeled as "composite" when it is plainly a conditional interaction.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: KnowledgeShareOfCapitalProgramCleanAccrual
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), dp))), RANK(NEG(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(SUB(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), SUB(SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1)), DELTA(txp, 1))), dp), at), 1))))
HYPOTHESIS: What determines how badly accounting misrepresents a firm is the knowledge share of its capital program — expensed research relative to research plus the depreciation charge on physical capital — because a firm consuming physical capital gets a recognized asset base while a firm consuming research gets none; among such knowledge-weighted firms, clean accruals confirm the reported earnings are conservative rather than managed.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio
REASONING: This intangible leg is new to the archive in both variable set and economics: it is a bounded composition measure of the firm's investment mix (knowledge versus physical capital consumption) rather than any spending-to-assets or spending-to-equity intensity, so it is not a monotone transform of an existing leg and it reorders capital-light service firms against R&D-heavy manufacturers. It is defined for every firm, keeps the balance-sheet-accrual coverage advantage, and pairs the expense-treatment channel (what gets capitalized) directly with the accrual channel.
REASONING_END: none

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: InvisibleVersusAccrualExpansion
EXPRESSION: SUB(RANK(RATIO(DELTA(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 1), at)), RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(SUB(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), SUB(SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1)), DELTA(txp, 1))), dp), at), 1)))
HYPOTHESIS: Firms expand in two accounting-visible ways: by adding expensed intangible investment, which shows up nowhere on the balance sheet, or by accumulating working-capital accruals, which inflate both assets and reported income; the firm whose expansion is invisible rather than accrual-based is systematically undervalued.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel
REASONING: This is a single centered composition variable contrasting two channels of growth rather than a gate multiplied by a signed leg, so it is structurally unlike every conditional interaction in the archive and cannot be produced by swapping the accrual definition into an existing signal. Both components are same-year flows scaled by assets and then ranked, so the contrast is unit-consistent, spans the full cross-section, and places accrual-financed expanders at the short pole and quiet invisible investors at the long pole.
REASONING_END: none
